title: toast vs dialog
rule: Toast only for confirmations, simple notifications, and low-priority alerts that must not fully interrupt. Dialog when the situation needs attention or a response. Do not use a dialog for a simple upload-complete.
pass_when: Low-priority confirmations/notifications use toast; situations that need attention or a response use dialog.
fail_when: Dialog for a simple upload-complete; or toast for a situation that needs attention/response.
overview: Toasts cover low-priority confirmations; dialogs cover situations that need attention or response.
apply_when: Choosing between toast and dialog after saves, uploads, or status changes.
not_when: Simple upload-complete moments that only need a toast, not a blocking dialog.
agent_hint: Use toast for low-priority notices; use dialog when attention or a response is required.
description: Spectrum reserves toasts for confirmations, simple notifications, and low-priority alerts that must not fully interrupt. Situations that need attention or a response belong in a dialog. A dialog for a simple upload-complete overblocks; a toast for a decision that needs a response underblocks. Match the layer to the urgency: toast for lightweight status, dialog when the user must engage.
do_not_claim: A winner vs NN/g modal 7 (`nng.modal-and-nonmodal-dialogs`); Ant Message vs dialog (separate rows).
